# OpenDrop/EWOD Adapter Fixtures

These fixtures cover the OpenDrop/EWOD dry-run adapter skeleton only.

They do not require OpenDrop, import an OpenDrop SDK, connect to device IO, provide hardware proof,
claim HIL execution, or prove physical droplet movement.

Transport planning fixtures define disabled `none` and `serial_experimental` configurations plus
deterministic command-stream examples. They do not copy or vendor GaudiLabs/OpenDrop firmware or
controller code, and the command streams are untested experimental planning artifacts, not hardware
support.
